rationale: The agent performed a modifying write (changed the air purifier and issued a gift card refund) without first confirming the action with the user, violating the policy to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. It also did not first check or communicate shipping/arrival status or attempt an item cancellation if unshipped, which was the user’s stated first preference. Additionally, the final message asserts a specific refund amount and new order status without showing tool results supporting those details in the conversation. Overall, the request was not completed in line with policy.
